contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ DN CONST [---] ; R/ VICTORIAE [DD AVGGQ] NN

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), Two Victories issue of 347-348, Trier mint, Reece period 17; RIC vol. 8 no. 211. Obverse description: Bust diademed and cuirassed right; vertically lined hair. Obverse inscription: DN CONST [---]. Reverse description: two Victories facing each other holding wreaths; object resembling fir tree between them. Reverse inscription: VICTORIAE…
